reference.method: Original JPEG; neutral-ink threshold L<140 (roughly 50% edge coverage), red excluded; +/-1 native pixel uncertainty. No upscaling for measurements.

advisory_review_subset.basis: Two closest flat-stem matches among requested values. Advisory only; all values visible. Not approval.

apostrophe: One independent punctuation correction, drawn with five intentional cubic segments to the original measured envelope. Shared unchanged across all weights. Not Candidate B geometry; no custom alphabet.
limitations: Weight match does not establish glyph-shape fidelity.
No raster curvature-sign-flip or IoU score used as approval criterion.
Full overlays expose required common-width spacing changes as well as shape differences.
